'''Imperial Bomber Command''' was a military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] that fought in the [[Invasion of Taris]].

==History==
During the Sith Empire's invasion of Taris in [[3642 BBY]], Bomber Command assisted Imperial heroes in destroying [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Race for the Kill|Taris}}</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
